Title: Willow
Description: A swineherd reluctantly becomes the protector of a prophesied infant princess, dragging him into a war against an evil queen's sorcery across a fantasy kingdom.

Title: Conan the Barbarian (1982)
Description: Enslaved as a boy after his village is destroyed, a warrior grows into a powerful fighter who sets out across a primeval world to hunt down the cult leader who slaughtered his family.

Title: Solomon Kane
Description: A reformed swordsman trying to leave violence behind is forced back into combat to save a young woman from a sorcerer's dark forces.

Title: The 13th Warrior
Description: A banished Arab diplomat falls in with a band of Norse warriors and must help them face a mysterious enemy that may be more than mere legend.

Title: Kingdom of Heaven (Director's Cut)
Description: A grieving blacksmith joins his estranged father's crusade to Jerusalem, where he becomes entangled in the political and religious struggle for control of the Holy Land.

Title: Centurion
Description: Survivors of a Roman legion ambushed in ancient Scotland must flee through hostile territory while being hunted by vengeful Pict warriors.

Title: Overlord
Description: On the eve of D-Day, paratroopers sent to destroy a Nazi radio tower discover the occupying forces are running a horrifying experiment in a nearby village.

Title: 30 Days of Night
Description: An isolated Alaskan town's month-long polar night becomes a feeding ground for a pack of vampires who descend once the sun disappears.

Title: Daybreakers
Description: In a world where vampires dominate and the human blood supply is running out, a hematologist races to find a substitute before society collapses.

Title: John Carter
Description: A Civil War veteran is mysteriously transported to Mars, where he gets swept into a conflict between warring civilizations and discovers extraordinary new abilities.

Title: Stardust
Description: A young man crosses into a magical realm to retrieve a fallen star for his beloved, only to find the star is actually a woman being hunted by a witch and feuding princes.

Title: Warcraft
Description: As orc clans pour through a portal into the human kingdom of Azeroth, an unlikely alliance forms to determine whether the two races can avoid all-out war.

Title: Jupiter Ascending
Description: An ordinary cleaning woman learns she's secretly genetic royalty with a claim to Earth itself, drawing the attention of a ruthless cosmic dynasty.

Title: King Arthur: Legend of the Sword
Description: A street-raised young man discovers his true identity after pulling a legendary sword from stone, setting him on a path to reclaim the throne from a tyrant uncle.

Title: Bram Stoker's Dracula
Description: A centuries-old count travels to Victorian London, where he becomes obsessed with a woman who resembles the wife he lost long ago.

Title: Underworld
Description: A vampire warrior locked in an ancient war with werewolves finds her loyalties tested when she falls for a human caught between both species.

Title: Van Helsing
Description: A famed monster hunter is sent to Transylvania to stop Count Dracula and ends up entangled with werewolves, Frankenstein's creature, and a cursed family's fate.

Title: Dracula Untold
Description: A Transylvanian prince makes a desperate pact with a dark power to save his kingdom and son from the invading Ottoman army, at the cost of his own humanity.

Title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
Description: After a painful breakup, a heartbroken man undergoes a procedure to erase all memory of his ex, only to revisit their relationship as the memories are being wiped away.

Title: Valerian
Description: Two special operatives serving a sprawling space metropolis race to track down a hidden threat that endangers the safety of the entire universe.

Title: Ready Player One
Description: In a near-future where most of life is lived inside a vast virtual world, a teenager hunts for a hidden prize left behind by the simulation's late creator.

Title: Annihilation
Description: A biologist joins a small team venturing into a quarantined zone where the laws of nature have gone strange, searching for answers about her husband's disappearance there.

Title: Donnie Darko
Description: A troubled teenager who narrowly avoids a freak accident starts receiving unsettling visits from a figure in a rabbit suit who warns him the world will end in four weeks.

Title: Dark City
Description: A man wakes up with no memory and is accused of a string of murders, then uncovers a hidden conspiracy controlling the perpetually nighttime city around him.

Title: Event Horizon
Description: A rescue crew investigates a research ship that vanished years earlier, only to find it's returned carrying something deeply wrong.

Title: Dragonslayer
Description: A sorcerer's apprentice is left to fulfill his master's promise to slay a dragon terrorizing a medieval kingdom, using untested magic and nerve.

Title: 28 Weeks Later
Description: Months after a rage virus devastates Britain, returning survivors and occupying soldiers discover the outbreak isn't as contained as authorities claimed.

Title: Dawn of the Dead (2004)
Description: A small group of survivors barricades themselves inside a shopping mall as a fast-spreading outbreak turns the population into ravenous zombies.

Title: Dragonheart
Description: A disillusioned knight teams up with the last dragon on Earth to con villagers out of money, until the dragon's old bond with a cruel king forces a reckoning.

Title: Eragon
Description: A farm boy who finds a mysterious stone discovers it's actually a dragon egg, thrusting him into a destiny as a Dragon Rider opposing a tyrannical king.

Title: Pacific Rim
Description: As giant sea monsters emerge to ravage coastal cities, humanity's last defense is a fleet of massive pilot-controlled robots fighting back one battle at a time.

Title: The Girl with All the Gifts
Description: In a Britain ravaged by a fungal plague that turns people into flesh-eaters, a scientist and teacher escort a uniquely immune young girl who may hold the cure.

Title: The Prestige
Description: Two rival stage magicians in Victorian London escalate their feud into increasingly dangerous sabotage as each tries to discover the other's greatest trick.

Title: The Golden Compass
Description: A girl from a world where souls take animal form sets out to rescue kidnapped children and uncover a conspiracy involving a mysterious substance called Dust.

Title: The Green Knight
Description: King Arthur's reckless nephew embarks on a perilous quest to honor a reckless promise made to a towering, otherworldly knight made of bark and leaves.

Title: Outlander
Description: An alien warrior crash-lands in Iron Age Norway and must unite feuding Viking clans to defeat the monstrous creature that followed him to Earth.

Title: Priest
Description: In a walled society built to keep vampires out, a warrior-priest defies church law to hunt down the creatures who abducted his niece.

Title: The Last Legion
Description: After Rome falls, a deposed boy emperor and his loyal protector flee to Britain in search of a legendary legion, planting the seeds of the Arthurian legend.

Title: Ironclad
Notes: Wishlist — Carver asked for this one
Description: A small band of knights and mercenaries holds a castle under brutal siege by King John's army in the aftermath of the Magna Carta's signing.

Title: Dog Soldiers
Description: A squad of British soldiers on a routine training exercise in the Scottish Highlands finds itself hunted by something far deadlier than the enemy they were training against: a pack of werewolves.

Title: Apocalypto
Description: In the waning days of the Mayan civilization, a young hunter is captured for sacrifice and must fight his way home through the jungle after escaping his captors.

Title: The Descent
Description: Six women on a caving expedition in the Appalachians get trapped underground after a tunnel collapse, only to discover the cave system is already inhabited.

Title: Pathfinder
Description: A Viking boy raised by a Native American tribe after a shipwreck grows into a warrior who must defend his adopted people when his former countrymen return to raid the coast.

Title: The Man in the Iron Mask
Description: The aging Musketeers reunite to free a secret prisoner who may be the cruel French king's identical twin, plotting to swap him onto the throne.

Title: Dredd
Description: A no-nonsense street judge and his rookie partner get trapped inside a towering slum block run by a ruthless drug lord, forced to fight their way up floor by floor.

Title: The Lost Boys
Description: After moving to a sleepy California town, a teenager falls in with a gang of motorcycle-riding boys who turn out to be vampires, leaving his younger brother to find a way to save him.

Title: Mr. Nobody
Description: A 118-year-old man, the last mortal alive in a future of immortals, looks back on the branching paths his life could have taken depending on a single childhood choice.

Title: Near Dark
Description: A small-town farm boy is bitten by a mysterious drifter and pulled into her nomadic family of nocturnal predators roaming the rural Southwest.

Title: Sunshine
Description: Decades in the future, a crew of scientists and astronauts pilots a ship carrying a massive payload meant to reignite Earth's dying sun, with everything going wrong along the way.

Title: The Eagle
Description: A young Roman officer in ancient Britain sets out beyond the frontier with only his slave for company to recover his disgraced father's lost legionary standard.

Title: Pandorum
Description: Two crew members wake from hypersleep on a generation ship with no memory of their mission, only to find the vessel overrun by something hostile and the truth far stranger than they expect.

Title: Peninsula
Description: Years after the zombie outbreak devastated the Korean peninsula, a former soldier is pulled back into the quarantined wasteland on a dangerous retrieval job.

Title: The Mist
Description: After a freak storm, a small Maine town is swallowed by a strange mist hiding deadly creatures, trapping a group of locals inside a supermarket where panic proves as dangerous as the fog.

Title: Triangle
Description: A woman on a boating trip with friends boards an apparently abandoned ocean liner after a storm and becomes caught in a looping nightmare she can't explain.

Title: Season of the Witch
Description: Two disillusioned Crusader knights returning from war are ordered to escort an accused witch to a remote monastery, uncertain whether she's innocent or genuinely cursed.

Title: Black Death
Description: During the bubonic plague, a young monk guides a band of soldiers to a remote village rumored to be untouched by the disease, and possibly protected by darker forces.

Title: Pan's Labyrinth
Description: In fascist Spain, a lonely girl escapes her grim home life and cruel stepfather by following a faun into a hidden fantasy world that demands she complete dangerous trials.

Title: The Fountain
Description: Across three intertwined timelines spanning a thousand years, a man searches for a way to save the woman he loves from death itself.

Title: REC
Description: A TV reporter and her cameraman get sealed inside a Barcelona apartment building during a quarantine, capturing on tape the rapid spread of a violent, infectious outbreak.

Title: Timecrimes
Description: A man who stumbles onto a hidden time machine after witnessing a crime in the woods triggers a spiraling chain of paradoxes as he keeps trying to fix his own mistakes.

Title: Trollhunter
Description: A team of student filmmakers investigating mysterious bear killings in Norway instead tag along with a weary government employee whose actual job is hunting trolls.

Title: Bone Tomahawk
Description: A small-town sheriff leads a rescue posse into the wilderness after townspeople are abducted by a cave-dwelling tribe rumored to be more monster than man.

Title: The Ritual
Description: Four old friends hiking through a Swedish forest in memory of a fallen friend take a shortcut that leads them into ancient, hostile territory.

Title: I Origins
Description: A molecular biologist obsessed with mapping the evolution of the human eye stumbles on a discovery that challenges his strictly rational view of existence.

Title: Outpost
Description: A team of mercenaries hired to escort a businessman to an old WWII bunker in Eastern Europe finds the site still guarded by something that should not have survived the war.

Title: Stake Land
Description: In a vampire-ravaged America, a hardened hunter takes an orphaned teenager under his wing as they travel north searching for a rumored safe haven.

Title: The Endless
Description: Two brothers return to the secluded UFO-death-cult camp they fled a decade earlier, only to find the bizarre phenomena that made them leave were not exaggerated.

Title: The Last Duel
Description: In 14th-century France, a knight challenges his former friend to a duel to the death after his wife accuses the man of assaulting her, with her own fate riding on the outcome.

Title: Dead Snow
Description: A group of Norwegian students on a ski trip in the mountains accidentally wake a battalion of undead Nazi soldiers still guarding their wartime plunder.

Title: Beowulf & Grendel
Description: A Norse warrior travels to a Danish kingdom terrorized by a monstrous outcast, only to find the creature's grudge against the king is more personal than legend suggests.

Title: In the Name of the King
Description: A farmer's peaceful life is shattered when a savage army slaughters his family, setting him on a path to becoming the warrior a kingdom needs to survive an otherworldly invasion.

Title: Ex Machina
Description: A young programmer invited to a tech CEO's remote estate is tasked with determining whether the reclusive genius's android creation has true consciousness.

Title: Let the Right One In
Description: A bullied, lonely boy in a Stockholm suburb forms a close bond with the strange new girl next door, unaware she is a centuries-old vampire tied to a string of local deaths.

Title: Coherence
Description: A dinner party among old friends unravels into paranoia and confusion after a passing comet triggers strange power outages and overlapping realities outside.

Title: Primer
Description: Two garage-tinkering engineers accidentally build a working time machine and quickly find themselves entangled in the unforeseen consequences of using it.

Title: Valhalla Rising
Description: A mute, one-eyed warrior who escapes slavery joins a band of Norse crusaders sailing for the Holy Land, only for their voyage to drift into something stranger and more hostile.

Title: The Man from Earth
Description: A university professor's farewell gathering turns into an all-night debate after he calmly claims to be over 14,000 years old and asks his colleagues to prove him wrong.
